schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the plugin manifest schema.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier for the plugin bundle.

name.description: Display name shown in catalogs and diagnostics.

version.description: Semantic version describing the plugin implementation.

description.description: Long-form summary of the plugin's capabilities.

requiredApis.description: Compatibility map keyed by API name with semantic version constraints.

settings.description: Optional plugin-level settings surfaced to the host.

supportedCapabilities.description: Capabilities implemented by the plugin and advertised during the Core handshake.

requiredTransports.description: Transports or endpoints the plugin requires to function (e.g., AOG-Link, core://guidance).

minimumRuntimeVersion.description: Minimum Nexus runtime version validated during plugin activation.

simProviders.description: Simulation providers bundled with the plugin.

leases.description: Lease declarations describing how the plugin acquires and maintains capability ownership.

reportSections.description: Report Builder sections exported by the plugin.

providerId.description: Identifier referenced by the simulation graph.

type.description: Fully qualified type name used to materialise the provider.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the provider.

mode.description: Acquisition mode requested from the Core capability arbiter.

timeoutSeconds.description: Lease renewal timeout budget in seconds.

recovery.description: Recovery strategy applied when the lease cannot be renewed.

displayName.description: Human readable name rendered in the Report Builder catalog.

description.description: Summary of the analytics or visuals produced by the section.

version.description: Semantic version of the section contract exposed by the plugin.

scopes.description: Report scopes (farm/season/job/session) supported by the section.

capabilities.description: Data dependencies advertised to the Report Builder orchestrator.

optionsSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for validating template-specified options.

defaultOptions.description: Suggested options applied when a template omits overrides.

notes.description: Implementation notes for operators or template authors.

deprecated.description: Marks the section as deprecated while keeping backwards compatibility.

reportSection.description: Manifest contract describing a report section contributed by the plugin.

reportSectionId.description: Stable identifier used by templates when referencing the section.

reportScope.description: Context scopes that the section is able to render against.

reportCapability.description: Named dataset or capability required by the section renderer.

pdf.description: Indicates that the section can render into the PDF output.

csv.description: Indicates that the section can produce a tabular CSV export.

geoJson.description: Indicates that the section can emit GeoJSON features.

reportOutputs.description: Declares which export surfaces the section supports.

region.description: Preferred report region for the section's primary rendering.

order.description: Relative ordering hint used by default templates.

column.description: Zero-based column index for multi-column PDF layouts.

columnSpan.description: Number of columns the section prefers to occupy.

rowSpan.description: Relative height budget for the section within a template.

sectionLayout.description: Default layout hint consumed by templates when no override is provided.

csv.description: Suggested CSV exports emitted when the template does not override.

geoJson.description: Suggested GeoJSON exports emitted when the template does not override.

defaultExports.description: Default export bundle suggestions provided by the section.

filename.description: Default filename proposed for the CSV artifact.

columns.description: Optional ordered list of exported column identifiers.

csvExportHint.description: Hint describing a CSV export emitted by the section.

filename.description: Default filename proposed for the GeoJSON artifact.

featureRole.description: Semantic role advertised for the exported features.

geoJsonExportHint.description: Hint describing a GeoJSON export emitted by the section.
